note: Pinned non-pip assets. Every download is verified by sha256 before use, staged, smoke-tested and swapped in atomically; on any failure the previous copy is kept. The ffmpeg build is BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, LGPL variant (no GPL components), release n8.1.3; sha256 computed on 2026-10-03 from the downloaded file. Old autobuild tags may be removed by the publisher: then the download fails cleanly and the bundled imageio-ffmpeg is used.
